name: logos-marquee
title: Logos Marquee
description: A single row of well-known company logos drifts sideways on a dark rounded panel and loops endlessly. Soft fades at each end hide the cut edges so the row appears to run on without a join.
use: You want a steady strip of client or partner logos to signal trust without taking much height.
avoid: Only five hardcoded brands are included, and a moving strip is slower to scan than a static grid.
a11y: The strip never stops and ignores prefers-reduced-motion; each logo does carry alt text. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark charcoal rounded panel holds one evenly spaced row of white and grey logo marks — Facebook, OpenAI, X, Apple and Google repeating — on a near-black field. The left and right edges dissolve into the background.
behaves: The row of logos glides steadily in one direction and loops without a visible gap; there is no pause control. Edge gradients dim each icon as it reaches either side.
customise: Replace the local logos array to choose which brands appear; each entry needs a name for the alt text and an image URL. Gap and fade colours are class name settings.
weight: light: Five repeated logo images on one CSS-animated strip.
